cornerstone.holders: All cornerstone investors (JSC International Investment Fund SPC for and on behalf of Shenghai SP, OAP IV (HK) Limited, GBAD Fund Management for and on behalf of the Managed Account of Mega Prime Development Limited, GBAD Fund Management for and on behalf of the Managed Account of Poly Platinum Enterprises Limited)
cornerstone.full_quote: Each of the Cornerstone Investors has agreed that it will not, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period of six months from and inclusive of the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”), dispose of any of the Offer Shares they have purchased pursuant to the relevant Cornerstone Investment Agreements, save for certain limited circumstances, such as transfers to any of its wholly-owned subsidiaries who will be bound by the same obligations of such Cornerstone Investor, including the Lock-up Period restriction.
cornerstone.basis: six months from and inclusive of the Listing Date; restricted period inclusive of Listing Date
cornerstone.notes: Heading reads 'RESTRICTIONS ON DISPOSALS BY THE CORNERSTONE INVESTORS' (p230); wording is 'six months from and inclusive of the Listing Date' (no parentheses).

controller_6m.full_quote: (a) in the period commencing on the date by reference to which disclosure of his or its shareholding in our Company is made in this prospectus and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date, dispose of, nor enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of the Shares in respect of which he or it is shown by this prospectus to be the beneficial owner
controller_6m.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(a): period commencing on the prospectus disclosure date and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date; computed as six calendar months from Listing Date

controller_12m.full_quote: (b) in the period of six months commencing on the date on which the period referred to in the above paragraph (a) expires, dispose of, nor enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of the Shares referred to in paragraph (a) above, if, immediately following such disposal or upon the exercise or enforcement of such options, rights, interests or encumbrances, he or it would cease to be a Controlling Shareholder
controller_12m.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(b): period of six months commencing on expiry of the (a) period, i.e. ends 12 months from Listing Date; disposal restricted if it would cause the shareholder to cease to be a Controlling Shareholder
controller_12m.notes: Paragraph (b) continues on p240 with a proviso permitting pledge/charge to an authorized institution.
